3) If we take the early-sign credit, is that applied as a one-time invoice credit or recurring discount on the term?

Thanks everyone — answers inline: 

1) Seat handling: We can place seats in a 60-day hold state (no charge) for transfers; after 60 days they are released. Ive added the hold language to the Transfer-Addendum.xlsx.

2) HubSpot bundle: The HubSpot sync bundle includes Outreach's connector license but does not cover HubSpot paid seat licensing. If you need HubSpot seat increases, that will be a separate cost. We list the connector as an add-on in the quote (one-time setup + monthly connector fee).

3) Early-sign credit: Applied as a one-time invoice credit on the first renewal invoice.

Attached is an updated quote with the 60-day hold option and a line item for the HubSpot connector. I've also flagged the transfer addendum for your legal and finance teams.

Next steps I propose:
- Sean: confirm target seat map (which Marissa provided)
- Laura (Finance): please flag if the invoice-credit approach is a blocker for procurement/PO processing
- Karthik: any contract constraints from our hiring forecast?

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute technical call for HubSpot API mapping next week.

Best,
